title: 初三信息表：面包下午场
source_notice: 初三公开普通期末转载完整题面/印本脚本/参考键已核，原音轨明确缺；地域学年学期只在标题，正文只见九年级英语，原校认证未建立，不当gold。本稿完整原创配套不补平原录音缺口。
timing_notice: 每段两遍；原卷未印精确停顿，本机听前后每题5秒及重播提示属审阅编排
instruction: 听一则消息，用听到的信息补全全部五空。每空一词或一个数字，时间单位p.m.已印在表中。消息读两遍；听前后各25秒是本机审阅编排。可核写法同等接受，未核形式待复核。

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Good morning. Here is news about the School Bread Afternoon next Wednesday. It starts at two in the afternoon and finishes at five. Small groups will make bread rolls together. The aim is to practise teamwork in the kitchen: everyone will have a different job, and no one should try to do everything alone. Before we begin, please wash your hands and put on an apron. When you move the trays, carry them carefully with both hands. Only the adult helpers will put trays into the hot ovens or take them out. The helpers will provide recipe cards, so there is no need to bring a cookery book. At the end, you can take your bread home in a paper bag. As well as enjoying the afternoon, we hope you will learn useful cooking skills that you can practise with an adult at home. Please sign up at the school office by Monday.
